scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../media-server && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:media-server && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: export NODE_ENV=production && npm run delete && npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.delete: pm2 stop ecosystem.config.cjs && pm2 delete ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.reset: npm run delete && npm run start
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run install:all && npm run build && electron desktop/main.cjs
scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npx rimraf desktop/dist || (sleep 2 && npx rimraf desktop/dist) && npm run install:all && npm run build && cd backend && npm prune --production && cd .. && electron-builder --mac dmg zip && cd backend && npm install
scripts.desktop:pack:dir: npx rimraf desktop/dist || (sleep 2 && npx rimraf desktop/dist) && npm run install:all && npm run build && cd backend && npm prune --production && cd .. && electron-builder --dir && cd backend && npm install
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npx rimraf desktop/dist || (sleep 2 && npx rimraf desktop/dist) && npm run install:all && npm run build && cd backend && npm prune --production && cd .. && electron-builder --win nsis && cd backend && npm install
